method: Scraped from https://www.etsy.com/your/shops/me/stats/listings/<id> via authenticated browser. Etsy exposes no API for shop stats.
raw_note: term_rows are captured VERBATIM from each table row's textContent, whitespace-collapsed only. Etsy renders each row twice (visible cells + an accessibility duplicate reading '<term>: <n>'), so the term text repeats within a row. Nothing here is corrected, deduplicated or spell-checked on purpose - 'paper embriodery template' is a real buyer's typo and is preserved as typed. The header row varies between listings: some tables are 2-column (Search terms | Visits), others 4-column (Search terms | Etsy | Google, etc. | Total visits). Parse downstream, not here.
